result.reason: Section 2.11 appropriately extends the licences to affiliates and contractors, but Section 2.2’s fully paid-up, perpetual licence is still not irrevocable. The assignment language also remains subject to consent where an M&A successor is a direct competitor, so it does not clearly provide the required successor transfer right. In addition, the new Section 2.10 materially expands geographic rights and pricing terms, which is unrelated to the licence-scope playbook and changes commercial intent more than necessary. The added affiliate language is generally professional, but the placement of Section 2.11 after Section 14.1 and the awkward drafting of Section 2.10 reduce overall quality.
